sections.Intro: This remedy is characterized by its action on the glandular system and the respiratory organs. It is useful in cases of enlarged glands and chronic inflammation of the mucous membranes. There is a general feeling of weakness and debility. It is also useful in cases of chronic bronchitis and syphilis.
sections.Head: Headache, with a sensation of weight in the forehead. Vertigo.
sections.Eyes: Eyes red and burning. Dimness of vision.
sections.Nose: Chronic catarrh of the nose. Dryness and obstruction. Sneezing.
sections.Throat: Irritation and rawness in the throat. Hawking of mucus. Cough. Enlarged tonsils.
sections.Stomach: Appetite poor. Nausea. Heaviness and pressure after eating.
sections.Respiratory: Shortness of breath on motion. Violent cough, with a sensation of oppression in the chest. Hoarseness.
sections.Glands: Enlarged and hard glands in the neck and other parts of the body.
sections.Relationship: Compare: Iodine; Kali iodatum; Calcarea iodata.
